title: PendingUpdateView
description: Composition of engagement offer state and change summary served to the UI detail (DISENO S7 (b) PendingUpdateView). Serving it records a SummaryViewed.v1 (EV-28, RF-048) when a summary is shown.
$comment: Source: DISENO 3.8.6 (view model PendingUpdateView), S7 (b)(d) GetPendingUpdateDetailQuery, (f), (h); PRD RF-035, RF-048, RF-050, RF-037. The full diff and the per-version breakdown are served by GET /v1/engagements/{engagementId}/pending-update/diff and /breakdown (DEC-34). Audience: public (S7). Residency: regional (engagement part) + global non-confidential summary content cached in the cell.

summary.description: Summary part (from S2 via SX-01b with cell cache).

summaryStatus.description: AVAILABLE = read from S2; CACHED = served from the cell Redis cache while S2 is unavailable (stale-while-error, immutable content); UNAVAILABLE = 'summary not available, see diff' degraded state (DISENO S7 (h), SX-01b, 3.8.6).

record.description: Cumulative current->target summary (RF-050); null when UNAVAILABLE or when there is no offer.

output.headline: Revenue section reorganised and one new checklist question

changes.description: A new question about related-party disclosures was added to the planning checklist.

output.impact: Engagements that apply v7 get one more planning question to answer.
